explication: Llama Cloud Services is a deprecated Python and TypeScript SDK for document ingestion, parsing, extraction, classification, indexing, retrieval, spreadsheet jobs, and agent-generated structured data. The principal workflow is: an application supplies files or queries, an SDK client invokes Llama Cloud APIs, asynchronous processing or retrieval occurs, and typed documents, classifications, extracted data, or ranked nodes return. Sampled code confirms file uploads, polling, presigned downloads, retrieval orchestration, and agent-data CRUD; several domain clients are represented from their tree paths without unsampled call details.
